body: From the DM-271 review (orchestrator, this run): two unpinned rules the Fireguard/mutation pass may flag — run scoping of the read-time lease settle (changing expireLeases(ctx, input.runId) to expireLeases(ctx) in timing.ts:348 passes all tests; add a second run with its own overdue lease) and the metrics summary's category-withholding rule (removing the changedSince branch in categoriesOf, metricsSummary.ts:133-139, passes; a fixture reporting tokens_input would pin it).
